learning_outcomes.text: Understand the principles and reference models of network management, as well as the technologies, protocols, and tools currently used.
Analyze, operate, and optimize existing management systems.
Plan, design, and implement management systems according to the needs of a network and its environment.
Use network management as support for analyzing, accounting for, planning, and optimizing other services deployed in the network.

syllabus_topics: Principles and patterns in network management
Autonomous, heterogeneous, homogeneous and integrated management
assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, continuous assessment (EC) requires a minimum grade of 5 out of 10. The final assessment (F) also requires a minimum grade of 5 out of 10 and can only be taken if continuous assessment has been passed. If both blocks are passed and attendance to practical classes is 80% or higher, the final grade is calculated as (0.5 x EC) + (0.5 x F). If EC is below 5.0, the student cannot take the final exam and the final grade will be the EC grade. For extraordinary and differentiated calls, evaluation consists of a theoretical exam (E) and a work (T), both requiring at least 5.0 out of 10.0, with the final grade calculated as (0.5 x E) + (0.5 x T) if all minimums are met.
